sql: SELECT json_build_object('ia_conversa', (SELECT json_agg(t ORDER BY t.custo_usd DESC) FROM (SELECT c.name AS empresa, count(DISTINCT u.conversation_id) AS conversas, round(sum(u.cost_usd)::numeric, 2) AS custo_usd, round((sum(u.cost_usd) / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT u.conversation_id), 0))::numeric, 4) AS usd_por_conversa, count(*) AS chamadas, string_agg(DISTINCT u.model, ', ') AS modelos FROM ai_agent_usage u JOIN companies c ON c.id = u.company_id WHERE NOT u.is_test AND u.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY c.name) t), 'por_tipo', (SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT kind, count(*) AS chamadas, round(sum(cost_usd)::numeric, 2) AS custo_usd FROM ai_agent_usage WHERE NOT is_test AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY kind) t), 'leads_novos_30d', (SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT c.name AS empresa, count(*) AS leads FROM campaign_leads l JOIN companies c ON c.id = l.company_id WHERE l.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10) t), 'outras_ia', (SELECT json_agg(t ORDER BY t.custo_usd DESC) FROM (SELECT function_name, round(sum(estimated_cost_usd)::numeric, 2) AS custo_usd, count(*) AS chamadas FROM ai_usage_logs WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY function_name) t)) AS r
